task.title: Filter corpus samples by verification command
task.objective: Select validated records when a verification command exactly matches text without executing it
acceptance_criteria: Any exact verification-command match selects the record
Records without verification entries do not match
Matching never executes or interprets command text
The predicate composes before limiting and preserves complete validation
